issue: onRevoke enqueues stopTunnel() but never stopSelf(), unlike ACTION_STOP (line 529); the service lingers as a background service and a START_STICKY recreation attempts a doomed tunnel restart (VPN revoked → establish() null → exception) broadcasting a spurious TUNNEL_ERROR to the UI
fix: Add stopSelf() after stopTunnel() inside the onRevoke lifecycle Runnable, matching the ACTION_STOP path.

issue: startTunnel catch puts raw e.getMessage() into EXTRA_ERROR_MESSAGE and Log.e without scrubSecrets(); libbox checkConfig/start errors can echo config fragments (server address, UUID) to logcat, unlike writeJavaCrashReport which scrubs
fix: Apply scrubSecrets() to the message string before the broadcast putExtra and Log.e call, consistent with the crash-report path.
